label: Google Doodle
notes: Google Doodle page 'Mark Twain's 176th Birthday' (launched Nov 30, 2011) with a short blog text by Doodler Jennifer Hom about the Tom Sawyer fence-painting scene. Little biographical data beyond the birthday.

description.value: A great writer and humorist, Mark Twain once said, "Against the assault of laughter nothing can stand." His characters are as sincere as they are funny and playful; his work is iconic and a part of literary history.

related_agent.value: Jennifer Hom (Doodle artist / author of the post)
